name: 2024 curated historical reference
source: nflverse player statistics, preserved in a commit-pinned public mirror
changes: Selected 14 named players and regular-season weeks 3–16; retained identity, week, team, opponent, standard fantasy points and receptions; renamed columns. No synthetic player outcomes.
limitations: Curated subset, not a league-wide universe or current feed.
Weeks 1–2 are intentionally not bundled; all history metrics refer to the loaded sample.
Missing player-week rows are not treated as zero and do not prove inactivity.
Team labels use the last observed historical record, so trades may not be known immediately.
No injury, depth-chart, roster ownership or live availability feed.
